sv.title: Investeringarna fortsätter minska i Kina
sv.summary: Utländska direktinvesteringar i Kina (FDI) minskade med 2,4 procent under januari-oktober, jämfört med samma period föregående år.

en.title: Investments continue to decline in China
en.summary: Foreign direct investment (FDI) in China decreased by 2.4 percent during January–October, compared with the same period the previous year.
